text_block_list.text: I was having an early morning meeting with Daiwa Scarlet, but...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... It's still bothering me.
No matter how many times I tie my hair, it always looks weird.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
E・xact・ly! Mama taught me this hairstyle herself, after all.
I always want to keep it looking totally perfect!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Ah, jeez! I can't concentrate!
I'm gonna go tie it again!

She couldn't get her signature hairstyle quite right,
and seemed unable to fully concentrate...
